items.title: Blazers Center Yang Hansen Gets Concerning News Ahead of New Season
items.author: Yahoo Sports
items.body_excerpt: Blazers Center Yang Hansen Gets Concerning News Ahead of New Season Yahoo Sports

items.title: Joe Cronin on Yang Hansen: "I thought he had a really promising offseason. He was really good in Summer League and played really well with the Chinese national team. Even before that, he had some good moments with the Remix."
